messages:
sam (DevEx): Hit a broken quickstart during a pairing session. README JS snippet still uses old package + API and the sample app crashes. raising here so we can patch and prevent new hires hitting this.
toni (SDK): can you paste the snippet?
sam (DevEx): current README shows:
```js
const Redwood = require('redwood-js-sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const r = await client.generate('Hello');
console.log(r.text);
```
sam (DevEx): runtime: TypeError: client.generate is not a function. Also onboarding quickstart lists REDACTED_API_KEY as the example env, which we've seen people accidentally deploy.
lee (docs): thanks for the report. v0.9 renamed packages and split APIs. examples should use @redwood/inference-js and the chat surface. we'll add a migration note and before/after snippets.
toni (SDK): note: in v0.9 we also changed retry defaults from 3 -> 0. docs still say retries: 3 which explains transient 429s some users reported when following quickstart. examples should set retry explicitly in the sample.
sam (DevEx): proposed after snippet to add to README:
```js
// after (updated)
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference-js');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, retry: { maxRetries: 2 } });
const resp = await client.chat.create({ messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] });
console.log(resp.choices[0].message.content);
```
lee (docs): I'll open a docs PR to update JS/Python quickstarts, call out the auth var rename (RW_API_KEY), the retry default change, and remove placeholder strings like REDACTED_API_KEY. I'll also add a short "migration checklist" to the top of quickstart.
toni (SDK): i'll add a runtime guard in SDKs that detects legacy env names (REDWOOD_KEY, OLD_API_KEY) and prints a clear upgrade error suggesting RW_API_KEY to help onboarding.
lee (docs): adding examples-smoke to the docs CI already; i'll expand it to run node/python samples and add a linter step that fails on placeholders matching /(REDACTED|PLACEHOLDER|YOUR_KEY)/i.
examples-bot: PR opened by lee: "docs: fix quickstart snippets + migration note" 10https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/914
ci-bot: examples-smoke queued for branch docs/fix-quickstart (runners: node, python)
ci-bot: examples-smoke failed (run 58): detected placeholder value 'REDACTED_API_KEY' in README -> blocking merge (good catch).
lee (docs): replaced placeholders with explicit: export RW_API_KEY=your_real_key and added a short security note. pushed fix.
ci-bot: examples-smoke passed (run 59)  node & python quickstarts executed against staging fixtures.
sam (DevEx): awesome. can we also add a short onboarding checklist item: "run examples-smoke locally" so new hires validate quickstart before shipping? tiny docs drift like this makes first-run DX terrible.
toni (SDK): agreed. will follow up with a small SDK patch that emits a helpful error when old env vars are present.
lee (docs): PR merged and backported to release/v0.9.x. closing loop 389
